opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Category maxima: New Projects and Commissions up to £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections up to £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications up to £5,000; Long-Term Research up to £20,000; Research and Travel up to £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (established and operating non-profit for at least 12 months) for exhibitions, catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display. Individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators may apply under the Research and Travel category. Individuals wishing to create/inform/develop their own practice are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Henry Moore Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, funding exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, and collection development (acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing, display). Categories: New Projects and Commissions; Acquisitions and Collections; Conferences, Lectures and Publications; Long-Term Research; and Research and Travel (for individuals). Applications are considered four times per year via Flexi-Grant; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Expenses allocation: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, Rest of world up to £1,000, plus accommodation provided in Leeds or Hertfordshire for the duration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers interested in Henry Moore specifically (at Studios & Gardens); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships, research only, no studio); established scholars for Senior Fellowships (six weeks).
opportunities.summary: Fellowship programme enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Foundation's research facilities in Leeds (Henry Moore Institute) or Hertfordshire (Henry Moore Studios & Gardens), including accommodation, travel and subsistence. Applications are currently closed for 2026/27 and the next round will open in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: £250 cash prize for BA dissertation and £250 cash prize for MA dissertation, plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the value of £50, copies of dissertations added to the Research Library, and publication of abstracts on the website

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to BA and MA students of all disciplines at UK universities, for a dissertation submitted within the past academic year at a UK university. Dissertation must relate directly to sculpture and not previously be published. Requires a letter from the academic organisation and a letter of support from an academic tutor or supervisor.
opportunities.summary: Annual prize awarding two prizes for extended pieces of writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture, open to BA and MA students of all disciplines. Submissions for the next prize will open in autumn 2026.
